title: Ashbury Rewards Console Reference: Elite Bonus Posting for Completed Stays
content:
A completed stay credited to the membership earns, at elite tiers, an elite bonus posted as its own elite bonus transaction naming the stay, separate from the stay's base points. The bonus is posted to the member's Ashbury Rewards account.

## Conditions of the result

- The elite bonus is posted only when the reservation's plan earns elite bonus points, only to a membership whose status is active, and a stay earns each earning component at most once.

## Capability

`post_stay_elite_bonus_1ee6f132` posts the elite bonus of a completed stay to an Ashbury Rewards account. One call records one stay earning transaction that names the stay, dated today, with the elite bonus points, and adds the points to the points balance of the membership. The member sees the bonus in their account activity and in their balance straight away.

## Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `post_stay_elite_bonus_1ee6f132`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership credited, as returned by the membership lookup for the verified member | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the completed stay the bonus is for, as returned by the reservation lookup | Identifier |
| `earning_source` | Earning component recorded on the transaction | Closed set of one value: `stay_elite_bonus` — the elite tier bonus earned on top of the stay's base points |
| `points` | Elite bonus points posted | Whole number of points, always positive; integer, no decimals, no thousands separators |

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the earning transaction created), `loyalty_member_id` (membership credited), `reservation_id` (stay named), `earning_source` (component recorded), `points` (integer points posted), `posted_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (points balance once the bonus is added). A returned `transaction_id` means the bonus is posted.

## Input and return (hypothetical values)

A posting of 2310 `points` with `earning_source` `stay_elite_bonus`, on an account holding 18200 points, returns `points` 2310 and `points_balance` 20510.
